Okayama (TI Circuit Aida) — survey report

Japan · Pacific GP (retired, classic:true) · theme green, day-only (night:false) · branch cursor/okayama-survey-a1 @ aa064aa · 72 frames · survey date 2026-10-15 · read-only (no js/css edited)

Evidence labels. measured = number from the built centreline / audit / frame in this session. source = claim from the brief, a code comment or a cited URL, not re-verified. guess = inference about a mechanism, not proven. Tooling merges applied (--no-ff): cursor/shared-shot-tooling-5b45 (weather/gallery tooling) and cursor/day-wet-lighting-b7b8 (PR #1979, daytime rain/storm no longer night-dark) both merged cleanly; verify-track okayama passes on the merged tree.

Summary

  • Layout and dressing are structurally healthy: verify-track OK, audit all-green (0 floating, 0 severe clips, coplanar 3 = baseline 3, ground buried 1 / flatCoplanar 1 within baseline).
  • The visible problems are mostly atmosphere/weather response (cobalt sky unchanged under overcast and fog; ghost tree reflections on wet surfaces; no authored night lighting) and identity gaps (fir conifers instead of broadleaf/bamboo, wide open verges instead of an "enclosed" lap, a flat green plane to the horizon, built elevation that contradicts the brief).
  • Top 5 are ranked in Defects; mechanisms with file:line are in Code & scenery deep-dive.

Dunlop bridge

Verdict: the bridge is present, correctly seated and emitted (modelDiagnostics: okayama-dunlop-bridge, 72 vertices = 3 boxes, required, 0 unsafe / 0 invalid / 0 clamped), but it reads as a bare second start gantry, not as a pedestrian bridge. 17 dedicated frames, 4+ angles, under day/dry, day/rain, dusk/dry and night/dry; every frame was checked on a contact sheet. The red-legged, black-beamed portal beyond it is the engine's start gantry (kit gantry:"box"), not the bridge — an early set of frames was re-shot because the two were easy to confuse.

Bridge-specific defects

  • Reads as a second start gantry. Two portals (grey bridge, red/black gantry) 18 m apart with similar proportions (frames 73, 75, 88, 76). Fix in scenery/okayama.js:343: add stair towers/handrails via a required modelGroup (register in tests/data/landmarks/okayama.json), a sign panel and/or a distinct colour; or move it over the infield side. measured (frames)
  • Piers stand at the road edge with no crash protection. Centreline offset ≈ 8.9 m sits inside the barrier band (8.1–9.9 m, wallStats); no armco/tyre protection is visible in front of either pier (frames 87, 89); the pit-side pier lands on the pit-wall line and appears to touch it. audit-circuit reports 0 severe clips, so any overlap is minor — needs a close-up to call. Fix: supportGap larger (e.g. 3–4 m) so piers clear the barrier, or armco returns around them. measured (frames) / overlap guess
  • Shadow checker / acne on pier inner faces and the deck underside (frames 77, 87), matching the pit-grandstand smear at f00; renderer-side, not this circuit's data. guess
  • No lighting at dusk/night: bridge disappears into black (frames 85-86), consistent with lamp:"none".
  • Floating / sunken / gaps: none seen. Piers meet the ground in 87/89 (ground-audit: 0 unsupported). The deck-to-pier joint has no visible gap.

Ranked defects (suggested fixes; none applied)

1 Sky ignores overcast/fog and the circuit palette (day)

Frames: day/dry, overcast, fog, all fracs — identical saturated-cobalt zenith with a hard horizon line; wet/rain/storm do change it. measured (frames)

Mechanism (read from source, not runtime-verified): with an explicit --tod day the sky is built in the else branch of js/lighting/atmosphere.js:235-250: zenith = [0.09−clr·0.04+ovc·0.28, 0.26−…, 0.95−ovc·0.24] where ovc comes only from _trackAtmoBias(def) (:683-690 — 0 for a "green" theme with no entry), not from the race weather; the circuit's own pal.zenith [0.38,0.48,0.60] (okayama.js:34) is only re-derived in the "default" branch. guess whether a normal (non-forced-tod) race hits the same branch.

Fix: engine-side (not this circuit's pair): feed raceWeather overcast/fog into the day-branch zenith/horizon, or give Okayama an _ATMO_BIAS entry so the humid inland look is greyer. Re-verify with a default-tod capture first.

2 Wet-surface tree reflections are broken vertical ghosts

Frames: day/wet, rain, storm; dusk/rain; night/rain — mirrored fir shapes on the clay/grass verge cut into stripes, most visible f17/f33/f50. measured (frames)

Mechanism: guess screen-space/planar reflection pass sampling a sparse depth buffer on the pale-clay terrain (reflecting objects fade to hatch lines). Not circuit data; the wide uniform clay verge (13+ m, scenery :238 tree ranks start at 13 m) makes it prominent here.

Fix: renderer/lighting item (docs/LIGHTING.md); optionally reduce wet reflectivity on the CLAY terrain material.

3 No authored night or dusk lighting; dusk sky and ground disagree

Frames: dusk/dry+rain, night/dry+rain. Night: black sky, no lit lamps (pit-side lamp mast at f00 has a head but no glow), road lit only by amber pools that travel with the car; dusk: navy sky above a warm amber ground with horizon bloom smear (f50). measured (frames)

Mechanism: night:false and lamp:"none" (okayama.js:27, 55), no lamp emitters (grep). The 4 uncovered tods therefore use generic sun/ambient presets. Per survey-track this is expected for non-night:true circuits; flagged because dusk/night are selectable in the game. source real Okayama has some floodlit events — not verified.

Fix: if night racing is wanted: set night:true + a lamp kit and floodlight masts through the scenery guard (scenery-dress); otherwise gate night on this circuit.

4 Built elevation contradicts the brief

measured peak +11.0 m at 0.368 (Hairpin region), low −11.1 m at 0.856, Hobbs (0.632) at −4.5 m on a descent; the stretch 0.40→0.60 loses 11 m. Brief: "back section climbs", Hobbs "at the top of the climb" (docs/tracks/okayama.md §3, scenery/okayama.js:590, 620).

Mechanism: elevations absent in the def, so relief is default terrain-derived; scenery comments describe a climb the geometry does not have.

Fix: hand to new-track/survey-track with a dated surveyed profile (the real circuit's relief is not established here — guess pending a source); until then correct the brief/comments rather than the dressing.

5 Tree species: fir conifers everywhere, brief wants broadleaf + bamboo

Frames: all day frames — layered fir cones. measured (frames)

Mechanism: furniture.tree:"fir" (okayama.js:55); every tree() call (scenery:245, 415, 451, 513, …) only tints colour (LEAF/BAMBOO/CEDAR arrays), so "camphor/oak/bamboo" comments (:81-85) do not change the silhouette.

Fix: check which furniture.tree kinds the engine supports (guess: a broadleaf/round-crown kind exists for other green circuits) and switch the def; for bamboo, a dedicated emitter if none.

6 Flat green plane to a hard horizon; ridges do not read as hills

Frames: every day frame — terrain ends and a flat green sheet meets the sky at a straight line; far ridges (hill() ×19) are not visible. measured (frames)

Mechanism: terrainOuter:110 (okayama.js:32); ridge anchors forced ≥ 62 m + w/2 + h (scenery:134-138) with 24–34 m widths and 11–26 m heights, and the guard silently drops many (header :44-52).

Fix: larger terrainOuter and/or a far ridge silhouette band; confirm drop count with the vert delta (~28 verts per surviving ridge).

7 Verges are wide open, not "enclosed"; armco not visible on the back straight

Frames: day/dry f50 (orbit + eye f50/f67): 13+ m of clay between a thin grass strip and the first tree rank, no visible barrier. measured (frames) Brief §6: trees and banks "right up against the tarmac".

Mechanism: tree ranks start at 13 m (scenery:238, comment :211 "was 9 — clipped bushes and pit boxes"); the full-lap guardrail(0,1,side,4) (:207) should sit at 4 m, but is not visible in these frames (guess: low-contrast ARMCO against the edge line, or dropped by the guard — needs a closer capture).

Fix: pull the first tree rank in once the clip audit allows (the 13 m was a clip workaround); verify the barrier with a trackside close-up.

8 Large featureless grey apron at the pit side

Frames: every f00 frame — a flat grey plane with one hard dark seam fills the left third. measured (frames)

Mechanism: six draped slabs pad(0.006+i·0.010, 1, 22, [26,0.08,22], APRON) (scenery:348-349) abut with a gap line; flat APRON [0.40,0.40,0.42] colour (:116) with no markings or detail.

Fix: vary slab tone, add paddock markings/garages' aprons, or shrink the slab set.

9 Smaller items

  • Moss S reads as one left (both peaks L) — turns[3..4] (okayama.js:49); fix in the layout (new-track), not dressing. measured
  • Duplicate guardrail runs (scenery:207 vs 387/439/520/658-659/685-686) and 389 tree drops — wasted emission; delete the block-level runs or the full-lap one. measured
  • Pixelated shadow smear (same artefact on the bridge piers, see Dunlop bridge) on the pit grandstand wall at f00 (dry day) — low-res shadow on a large flat face. guess renderer.
  • Coplanar baseline 3 spots and buried 1 prop remain (within baseline, not clean) — list via audit-circuit --checks coplanar,ground.
  • Length built 3688 m vs def/OSM 3704 m (−0.43 %).
  • Main stand is 110 m (scenery:366) vs brief "short, modest".
